messages:
alex: Heads-up — gitops apply for us-west-2/gpu-nodepool failed during node replacement. Several pods stuck on Pending with "failed to allocate addresses". Terraform shows node group template drift too.
samira: ugh. error logs?
ben: paste from kubelet: "failed to assign an IP from ENI: no available addresses" — that matches ENI IP exhaustion. Also saw mixed-instance-policy scaling up m6i and g5 weirdly.
infra-oncall: rolling back canary now. argocd rollback gpu-nodepool/canary -> see ci-bot
ci-bot: deploy triggered: argocd rollback gpu-nodepool/canary by infra-oncall at 1765432165. status: in_progress.
alex: suspect we hit ENI limits per instance + max-pods config mismatch after CNI helm upgrade. We recently bumped cni chart to v1.3.0 which changed ip allocation strategy.
samira: can you paste helm values? especially eniConfig and maxPodsPerNode.
alex: snippet:
```
# helm values
aws-node:
  config:
    ENIConfig: "gpu-usw2"
    MAX_PODS: 58
```
ben: terraform nodegroup template shows "instance_types = [g5.xlarge, m6i.large]" — mixing GPU & CPU types will change ENI counts. Also autoscaler labels not matching, so GPU taints aren't applied to m6i nodes.
eva: quick mitigation: cordon new m6i nodes, scale down mix to only g5, or set maxPods lower until ENI quotas freed. Also open support ticket for VPC IP quota if necessary.
samira: argocd shows helm-sync failed with 1/3 resources reconcile timeout. logs:
"Error: webhook timeout connecting to kube-system/aws-node-admission"
infra-oncall: rolling back CNI chart to v1.2.7 for canary. ci-bot?
ci-bot: helm rollback gpu-nodepool-cni to v1.2.7 initiated. status: success on 2/3 canary nodes, pending on rest.
ben: follow-up action items:
- pin nodegroup instance types in terraform module (no mixed policy for GPU pool)
- add eniConfig per AZ and ensure maxPods aligns with instance ENI
- add automation check in gitops CI to prevent CNI chart bump without ip calc
- add quota alert for VPC IP / ENI usage
alex: I submitted PR to terraform: fix instance_types, add max_pods variable, and update canary rollback script. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/infra/pulls/342
samira: nice. I'll validate in staging and run vpc-ip check in pipeline.
eva: note for postmortem: include cost impact estimate for forced node replacement (spot terminations + on-demand fallback) — flagged finance.
alex: thanks. ping me @samira once staging green and we'll resume full rollout. :thumbsup: 
ci-bot: thread closed? (deployment statuses will be posted to #eng-infra-deploys)
